background_notes.fact: If W is a K-linear subspace invariant under endomorphisms f and g, then W is invariant under f^r and g^r for every nonnegative integer r, under scalar multiples of those powers, and under finite compositions of the resulting operators.

grounds.reason: L1 gives x_K(W)⊆W and y_K(W)⊆W; W is a K-linear subspace.
A_r and C_r are scalar multiples of the corresponding nonnegative powers, and each T_ij is the stated scalar multiple of a four-factor composition.

background_notes.justification: The identity preserves W. Induction gives preservation by successive powers, since the next application again has its argument in W. Scalar closure of W gives preservation by scalar multiples. Successive application of any finite list of preserving maps stays in W.

background_notes.fact: For a finite K-basis (B_i) indexed by I, every vector has a unique expansion Σ_i c_i B_i; each B_i is nonzero, a nonzero vector has at least one nonzero coefficient, and a subspace containing every B_i equals the whole space. In particular a nonempty basis implies a nonzero space.

grounds.reason: B is explicitly a K-basis of V_K.
λ≥0 and K is a field.
I consists of the integers from 0 to λ, so I is finite and contains 0.

background_notes.justification: Spanning gives the finite expansion, and linear independence gives uniqueness. If B_i were zero, its coefficient-one relation would contradict independence, since 1≠0 in a field. All-zero coefficients yield the zero vector. A subspace containing the basis contains each scalar multiple and finite sum, hence every vector.

background_notes.fact: If a Lie algebra over K is spanned by elements x,y,h and its representation sends them to x_K,y_K,h_K, a K-linear subspace is a submodule exactly when it is invariant under these three operators.

grounds.reason: L_K is the scalar extension of the integer span of x,y,h, hence is spanned over K by their images.
The displayed operators are exactly the induced generator actions and define the stated L_K-action.
The brackets of the integer generators remain in their integer span.
W is a K-linear subspace satisfying the three invariance assumptions L1.

background_notes.justification: Every tensor in (Zx+Zy+Zh)⊗_Z K is a finite sum of pure tensors. Expand each integer-span entry and use tensor bilinearity to express it as a K-linear combination of the three generator images. Linearity of the representation makes its action the same combination of x_K,y_K,h_K, which preserves W by subspace closure. Conversely a submodule is invariant under each generator.
